metadata.target_role: Lead Product Manager (Growth Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace & PEO)

profile_summary: Entrepreneurial Growth and Platform Product Leader (former Founder and Senior PM) with 10+ years of experience driving product-led growth (PLG), full-funnel demand generation, GTM strategy, and AI-enabled enterprise platforms across hypergrowth and enterprise organizations. Proven track record of combining product, positioning, and multi-channel GTM levers to generate 2.5L+ sales-qualified leads (SQLs), lift funnel conversion by 35%, and protect ~$10M in annual enterprise revenue. Combines founder bias-for-action and commercial instincts with Computer Science technical fluency to align Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Operations.

sub_bullets: Owned enterprise platform strategy and execution across engineering and operations teams by architecting scalable operational tooling and governance workflows, ensuring 99.99% reliability for core business platforms

Built analytical KPI frameworks and executive dashboards tracking platform adoption, workflow efficiency, and cost savings to guide business cases, defining annual and quarterly roadmaps targeting a 20% reduction in incident volume
Aligned VP/CXO executives, engineering, finance, and operations stakeholders around strategic priorities, P&L trade-offs, and ROI business cases through monthly business reviews
Led strategic revenue-protection initiatives that reduced order cancellations by deploying automated recovery agents and incident handling workflows, saving ~$10M annually
Translated ambiguous operational and cross-departmental challenges into prioritized product requirements and automated workflow improvements across product, engineering, and operations teams
Partnered with operations, finance, and IT teams to streamline multi-stakeholder workflows across enterprise procurement, catalog discovery, and asset management programs

Spearheaded a unified enterprise asset lifecycle platform by partnering with finance and operations stakeholders to consolidate fragmented workflows and improve platform adoption, delivering ~$2M in annual cost savings

Designed and launched an AI-driven procurement and catalog platform using intelligent workflow agents to improve discovery, selection, and onboarding velocity for store setup teams, reducing operational cycle times by 20%
